extraction.name: arabic-img2md
extraction.description: A synthetic dataset of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations, created using HTML scraped from the Hindawi website. It enables accurate and scalable Arabic OCR training and evaluation.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset arabic-img2md was generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text to create paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content scraped from the Hindawi website, converted to PDFs, with Markdown text extracted to form 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Synthetic dataset generated using HTML scraped from the Hindawi website, paired Arabic book page images with Markdown representations
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi's web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Limitations include hallucination in arabic-small-nougat (generating irrelevant content), repetition issues in larger models for lengthy sequences, dataset biases limiting generalization, scalability challenges due to computational requirements, untested cross-script generalization, and difficulty handling complex layouts with dense tables, charts, or images.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset and models aim to promote the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic, contributing to broader accessibility of Arabic literature and NLP research.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The arabic-img2md dataset is intended for training Arabic OCR models. The arabic-books dataset (1.1 billion tokens extracted from Arabic literature) is intended as a resource for Arabic NLP and OCR research.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: A synthetic dataset of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations was created using HTML scraped from the Hindawi website, generating paired image-Markdown samples specifically for Arabic books.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The Aranizer-PBE-86k tokenizer was used to optimize tokenization efficiency, and torch.bfloat16 precision with Flash Attention 2 was employed for efficient training and inference. Input images of size 896×672 pixels are progressively downsampled through a series of operations, and the Donut encoder converts input images into a sequence of 588 tokens, each a 1024-dimensional vector.
